name: swift-render
description: Create launch videos from the actual SwiftUI, UIKit, AppKit, Metal, and artwork in an Apple app repository.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your Swift app into a launch video
interface.longDescription: Build native launch films from an Apple app's own code and assets. Inspect the app, adapt real components to deterministic film time, choreograph motion and a continuous soundtrack, review previews, and export multiple compositions. Rendering requires a local Mac and the Apple development tools. Includes source inventory and provenance checks plus a native SwiftRender starter. App-specific adapters are authored by Codex; arbitrary app targets are not automatically portable to macOS.
defaultPrompt: Make a launch video from this app's real Swift code and assets.
Revise the pacing and music in my existing SwiftRender film.
Adapt this launch film for vertical and 4:3 compositions.
